ns2:section.sectionText: This section has an online format. This course requires attendance in synchronous Online Discussion and Lab sessions that meet MTWR 10:00AM-10:50AM CST. Students in Math&CS may use this course to fulfill the Math 415 requirement in the major, while Statistics, Stat&CS, and other majors requiring Math 415 should check with their advisor. REGISTRATION DEADLINE: Registration for this course will close on Monday, June 14
